basic_details.job_title: Vijayapura District Court Peon Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 30 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Vijayapura District Court, Karnataka, has invited applications for 30 posts of Peon under Advt No. 01/2026. The online application is open from 5 November 2026 to 4 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online payment through SBI E-Pay Payment Portal using net banking, credit card, debit card, UPI ID, or QR code. Last date to pay the fee: 4 December 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: Passed SSLC or equivalent examination and ability to read and write Kannada.
qualification.details: Qualification: SSLC or equivalent examination passed Age limit: 18 to 45 years (as on 4 December 2026) | Other conditions: | Must be able to read and write Kannada

how_to_apply: Visit the Vijayapura District Court website and click on the online recruitment link.
Fill out the online application form completely and correctly.
Upload scanned photograph and signature as per specifications.
Pay the prescribed application fee through SBI E-Pay Payment Portal.
Download and print the completed application form for future reference.
important_instructions: Applications submitted through any mode other than online will be rejected.

content_sections.text: Qualification: SSLC or equivalent examination passed Age limit: 18 to 45 years (as on 4 December 2026) Other conditions: Must be able to read and write Kannada

content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online payment through SBI E-Pay Payment Portal using net banking, credit card, debit card, UPI ID, or QR code. Last date to pay the fee: 4 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: How Will Vijayapura District Court Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on percentage of marks secured in qualifying examination in 1:10 ratio Interview carrying a maximum of 10 marks Interview for shortlisted candidates based on academic marks

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: SSLC marks card Category certificate Income certificate Study certificate Rural reservation certificate if applicable

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Vijayapura District Court Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Visit the Vijayapura District Court website and click on the online recruitment link. Fill out the online application form completely and correctly. Upload scanned photograph and signature as per specifications. Pay the prescribed application fee through SBI E-Pay Payment Portal. Download and print the completed application form for future reference. Apply on or before 4 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications submitted through any mode other than online will be rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Vijayapura District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 4 December 2026. Applications opened on 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Vijayapura District Court Recruitment 2026?
Q3. How do I apply for Vijayapura District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Category-1 and PwD: Exempted. Category-2(a), 2(b), 3(a) and 3(b): Rs. 150. General Merit: Rs. 300.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 45 years (as on 4 December 2026).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Passed SSLC or equivalent examination and ability to read and write Kannada.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be able to read and write Kannada.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates appearing for qualifying exam whose results are awaited.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting based on percentage of marks secured in qualifying examination in 1:10 ratio. Interview carrying a maximum of 10 marks. Interview for shortlisted candidates based on academic marks.
